name: plan_extract
description: How vpt/plan_extract.py finds storeys, room labels, room outlines, walls and doors in a DXF, and how tools/export_plan.py draws each storey. Every value is a starting value: check it against your drawing (the export prints the checks R1-R5 with three outcomes).
layer_regex_note: Layer names <storey>_<nn>_[Abbruch_|Neubau_]<base> (the toolkit's convention, presets/synthetic_flat.json). Layers that do not match (e.g. 0, Defpoints) belong to no storey; when no layer matches at all, the whole drawing is one storey with key 'all' and every layer's base is its own name.
exclude_status_note: Layers of these statuses (walls to demolish) are left out of room labels, outlines, walls and doors. They are still drawn in the SVG.
label_area_regex_note: A label line matching this is the room's area text; the first other line is the room's name.
label_max_dist_m_note: A point outside every outline belongs to the nearest room label within this distance whose straight line to the point crosses no wall segment.

doors.note: A door is an ARC on a door layer with radius in radius_m (the leaf width) and sweep in sweep_deg. Hinge = the arc centre. Closed end of the arc (the opening): the end with NO line from the hinge when exactly one end has one (within leaf_tol_m; that line is the open leaf), else the only end that touches a wall segment (within leaf_tol_m: the far edge of the opening, where the wall goes on), else the end whose direction from the hinge runs along (within wall_angle_tol_deg) a wall segment of at least wall_min_len_m within wall_search_m of the hinge, else could not tell. Rooms on both sides: probe points from the middle of the opening along and against the open leaf at the side_probe_m distances (the first that finds a room wins). Two leaves whose closed ends lie within double_tol_m are a pair (double door).

walls.note: A wall segment runs along a room when at least min_overlap_share of its length lies within room_tol_m of the room's outline.

render.note: Each storey is drawn on a page of its model extent plus margin_m on every side, at 1:scale_1_to (page mm = model mm / scale_1_to). The symbols are sized in mm on that page.
